reviews.review:
I haven't completed any ending of this game (if there are multiple endings). It will be updated along with my progress.

So far the game is only available in Simplified Chinese, but I think it would be much better if they can finish English translation before releasing the game.

Have been only played for a couple of minutes and several questions have already come into my mind: If there exists a conflict, which would you choose, religion or freedom? And what is the boundary that people use to distinguish cult from non-cult religion?

Maybe I can get the answer from this game, maybe not. We'll have to wait and see.

[h1]Update 1 - 07/05/2016[/h1]
I have tried to go several lines with different chosen for questions. Unfortunately they all lead to the same ending (It's called "Bad End?"). I really like the artwork of this game, background images are really Western and you can feel something religion-related to it. Character arts are mostly Japanese, kawaii and moe girl(s), handsome boy (or maybe a man). The voice acting is really another story. So far I've only heard voice for 3 people: Christina, Mr. Rector and Old Granny. Christina has the best voice acting quality, period. Old Granny is okay, but Mr. Rector is totally a creepy guy hiding into a handsome body based on the voice acting. Although it's a visual novel, it does contain puzzles that require you to think for at most a couple of minutes. There are voice missing here and there. Some texts are not matching with voice acting. But overall, the experience is mostly pleasant. Did I understand the story behind this game? Not really, I'm still confused about so many words mentioned in the game. But at least I can answer one question: What would be your choice if you have to sacrifice freedom for/to peace?

I think you all know my choice.

[h1]Update 2 - 07/08/2016[/h1]
Finally completed the game with the help of official walkthrough. I don't like the ending, at all. And I regreted all things that I have done to achieve this ending. (I will talk more about this later in "Spoiler" section) The fact that there is only one certain way to achieve the true ending (not happy, again, later in "Spoiler" section) really annoys me. You pretty much have to go with the official walkthrough in order to achieve it, otherwise it will just be endless death. Old Grandpa also features voice acting but it's just as lousy as Mr. Rector. There are only 6 save slots in the game. Maybe it's enough for you, but for people like me who want to save progress constantly, it's not enough at all. Overall, it's worth trying, when you are able to understand the story in this game.

[h1]Spoiler: (Please read if you have completed the game or do not have intention to purchase the game but still want to know the story.)[/h1]
[spoiler]God's One Day World, yes, the world has only one day. After midnight, the world will be reset to the beginning of the same day, over and over again. You are trapped into the world, and the only way to escape from this world is to collect clues left by The Holy Book. Christina knew all of this, and she trusted you all the time. But in the end, she still held up the dagger, facing you, and stabbed it into her own chest. Yes, she loved you so much that she can give up the world she relies on in order to let you escape from the world. That, however, does not mean that she's dead in normal world. She just got polluted by Devil's curse and finally, she decided to sacrifice herself to let the God respawn, to let you respawn.
And there you are, escaped from the one day world, living in a world without Christina. Is this really what you want? Is this what you are trying to pursue for such a long time? Do you really think the one day world with Christina is really that bad?
I so wish I didn't complete this ending.[/spoiler]
